meta_title: Gardens of Smiles | Landscape Architect Birmingham
meta_description: Gardens of Smiles is a Birmingham landscape architect specialising in bespoke garden design and build. Expert landscape solutions. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Bespoke Garden Design & Build — Local to Birmingham
hero_subhead: Transform your outdoor space with expert landscape design tailored to your home, budget, and style.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From initial concept through to finished garden, we handle every aspect of your landscape project with precision and creativity.

services.title: Garden Design & Visualisation
services.desc: Detailed plans and 3D renderings of your new garden before work begins. We listen to your ideas and create a design that maximises space, light, and usability.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping Installation
services.desc: Expert laying of natural stone, porcelain, block paving, and decking. Every surface is built to last, with proper drainage and finishing that enhances your home's value.

services.title: Planting & Garden Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection and establishment tailored to your soil, aspect, and maintenance preferences. We create sustainable, low-maintenance gardens or lush cottage-style borders.

services.title: Water Features & Garden Lighting
services.desc: Bespoke ponds, fountains, and ambient outdoor lighting that transform your garden by day and night. Adds character and extends the enjoyment of your outdoor space.

services.title: Boundary & Screening Solutions
services.desc: Custom fencing, hedging, pergolas, and screening tailored to your privacy and aesthetic needs. Practical solutions that define your garden's character.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Ongoing seasonal care including pruning, weeding, and monitoring. Keep your newly landscaped garden looking pristine with our flexible maintenance packages.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We make sure yours reflects who you are.
about_para_1: Gardens of Smiles was founded in 2007 by landscape designer Michael Palmer, who saw an opportunity to bring thoughtful, bespoke design to Birmingham homeowners tired of generic garden solutions. Over 18 years, we've transformed more than 250 outdoor spaces—from compact urban courtyards to sprawling family gardens. Michael trained in horticulture and landscape design, and every project is guided by an understanding of both plants and people.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on listening. We don't impose templates; we ask questions, understand your vision, and create gardens that work as hard as they look beautiful. Customers come back to us because we balance creativity with practicality, and because we deliver on time and on budget. Working from King's Norton, we've become a trusted name across Birmingham and the wider West Midlands.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Michael completely transformed our back garden. We had no idea what we wanted, but he listened to us, showed us ideas, and created something we absolutely love. The patio work is flawless and the planting is thriving. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Susan T.

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. We were nervous about cost, but Michael was transparent and delivered exactly what we'd agreed. The new pergola and lighting have made our garden feel like a different space. Best investment we've made in the house.
reviews.author: James M.

reviews.text: As a busy working couple, we appreciated that Michael managed the whole project. His team was respectful, tidy, and professional. Our garden is stunning and low-maintenance, which is exactly what we needed. Already planning our next project with him.
reviews.author: Rachel D.
